metadata.title: A Ballantine-Type Factorization of Diffeomorphisms
metadata.abstract: We show that on a compact, connected, Riemannian manifold without boundary, every isotopic to the identity diffeomorphism can be written as a finite composition of optimal mass transport maps.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 证明闭连通黎曼流形上同伦于恒等的微分同胚可分解为有限个最优质量输运映射。
analysis.breakthrough: 建立输运映射与微分同胚群的生成联系。
analysis.limitations: 只对恒等分支和紧无边界流形成立；需核对输运代价及光滑条件。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
analysis.priorityReason: 把度量输运与整体几何联系起来，具有基础工具价值。
